senses.definition: [Of one variable or unit of measurement which has a known relationship to another] Using equivalent expressions that use one variable in place of expressions involving the other.
senses.example: If x=2y then 5x can be expressed in terms of y as 10y.

senses.definition: In relation to a particular aspect; with respect to; as regards; concerning; regarding.
senses.example: I switched to a different bank for better customer service, but there was little difference in terms of interest rates.

senses.definition: As an approach or way of proceeding.
senses.example: We had been thinking in terms of purchasing those notes on the market, since they were selling at a discount.
